form_analysis.feedback: Solid aftercare form for an oxygen facial, focusing on maintaining the treatment's immediate glow and hydration benefits. Good emphasis on gentle care and sun protection. Appropriately minimal given the non-invasive nature of the treatment, but could be enhanced with more specific guidance on product compatibility and managing rare reactions.

form_data.introduction: This aftercare advice will help you preserve the radiant glow, hydration, and revitalising benefits of your oxygen facial treatment and support your skin's overall health.

instructions.general_directive: For the next 24-48 hours, treat your skin gently to lock in the infusion of oxygen and nutrients.

sections.title: Immediate Post-Treatment Feel and Appearance
sections.content: Your skin should feel instantly refreshed, plumper, and look noticeably brighter with a healthy glow. There is typically little to no downtime. Any mild redness from the infusion process should fade within 30-60 minutes.

sections.title: Hygiene and Cleansing
items: You may wash your face normally after 4-6 hours. We recommend using a gentle cleanser to avoid stripping the skin of the beneficial serums infused during the treatment.
Use lukewarm water and pat your skin dry gently.
Avoid harsh scrubs or abrasive cleansing tools for 24 hours.

sections.title: Skincare Product Guidance
items: You may immediately resume your regular skincare routine. The oxygen facial is highly compatible with most products.
To amplify results, consider using hydrating and antioxidant-rich serums (like hyaluronic acid or vitamin C) as these synergise well with the treatment.

There are typically no restrictions on active ingredients (like retinoids or AHAs) post-oxygen facial, as it is non-exfoliating and non-traumatic. However, if you have sensitive skin, you may choose to delay strong actives for 12-24 hours.

sections.title: Activity and Environmental Restrictions
items: Avoid strenuous exercise and heavy sweating for 12-24 hours to allow the infused products to fully penetrate without being washed away by sweat.
Avoid saunas, steam rooms, and very hot showers/baths for 24 hours, as excessive heat can cause flushing.

sections.title: Sun Protection
sections.content: Maintain your daily sun protection habit. While the treatment itself does not increase photosensitivity, protecting your newly revitalised skin is always essential. Apply a broad-spectrum sunscreen (SPF 30+) daily.

sections.title: Makeup Application
sections.content: You may apply makeup immediately after the treatment if desired. Your skin's improved texture and glow may mean you require less makeup. Ensure your application tools are clean.

sections.title: Hydration and Nutrition
sections.content: Support the treatment from within by drinking plenty of water. A balanced diet rich in antioxidants will help maintain the brightening effects. Avoid excessive alcohol for 24 hours to prevent dehydration.

sections.title: Possible Skin Reactions (Rare)
sections.content: While extremely uncommon, if you experience persistent redness, itching, or small raised bumps, you may be sensitive to a specific serum infused during the treatment. This should resolve within 24 hours. If it persists, discontinue use of any new sample products given and contact your therapist.

sections.title: Maximising and Maintaining Results
items: The peak "glow" and hydration are most pronounced for 2-3 days post-treatment.
For cumulative and long-term benefits, especially for dullness or dehydration, a series of treatments (e.g., every 2-4 weeks) is recommended.
The treatment is excellent for pre-event preparation due to its immediate results and lack of downtime.
